purpose: Conservative engineering screen of received voltage summaries for exploratory auxiliary supervision; not validated brain-state labels
contact_rule: Both bracketing contact packets must report good on AF7 and AF8; other channels are not used as targets.
flatline_definition: At least 128 identical consecutive received values in any channel; broken by missing original rows; row count does not imply verified physical duration
range_rule: Reject values at or outside documented limits; do not treat the observed 1450 value as an established Athena saturation limit
target_definition: Two frontal channel means and two log1p population variances; original eight-channel aggregate verified before selecting AF7 and AF8.
limitations: Host-receipt clocks do not identify hardware acquisition latency.
Marker padding and 90 percent retained-row requirement are fixed engineering choices, not calibrated neuroscience criteria.
The general relay voltage specification may not expose every device-specific saturation boundary.
Good contact markers and movement screening do not exclude all ocular, muscle or reference artifacts.
Raw-voltage means retain device/reference offsets and must not be interpreted as cognitive ratings.
reason: All-four-channel screen accepted0/1020 windows. Marker audits show poor TP9/TP10 contact and predominantly good AF7/AF8 contact; pinned author preprocessing exports AF7/AF8.
